summary:

Sister Nicole Jellings joined us for the conversation. Deliver to her later in the evening, after getting home, a link to the "Preparing for Your Patriarchal Blessing" Google document that is linked here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/10cWMPeEr4UlExjaeNZmOVQfLhK0C7hox8ZKcmeDy76A/edit?usp=sharing

visit_title: President Henry, Hayden, Bishop conversation about advancing to the Melchizedek priesthood & considering a mission
summary: Conversation around Hayden's spiritual development and future steps in the church. Dave Houssian and Pres. Ryan Henry discuss Hayden's progress, including his baptism in October and potential advancement to the Melchizedek priesthood. They emphasize the importance of covenants with God and the readiness to make promises. Hayden expresses a desire to focus on his career before considering a mission. Dave Houssian reassures him about financial support for a mission, should he deside to go. The discussion also touches on the benefits and challenges of serving a mission, including potential career disruptions. The meeting concludes with a prayer for guidance and support.
follow_up_description: Meet with Bishop Houssian around the May 15–16 State Conference period to discuss readiness for Melchizedek Priesthood ordination and clarify any questions about the covenant.

visit_title: Working to get clearance to be re-baptized
summary: John Michael Carmichael is contemplating baptism but is uncertain about his belief in the church president as a true prophet. Dave Houssian shares his personal experience of witnessing the Prophet's presence, emphasizing the spiritual confirmation he felt. John recounts his past church involvement, including leaving the church at age 21 and his inability to find his records despite providing all necessary details. Dave assures John that the church will investigate further and, if necessary, proceed with his baptism. John's birthplace is confirmed as St. Pete, Florida, and he is asked to provide additional information to facilitate the process.

visit_title: Follow up detail about John's previous membership in the church
summary:
Full name: John Michael Carmichael
Birthdate: December 8, 1979
Birthplace: St. Petersburg (St. Pete), Florida

History with the Church leading up to resignation (as stated or clearly implied in the conversation):
• Baptized member in youth: John and his baby sister were baptized into the Church when they were younger, indicating they were raised in the Church.
• Left the Church as a teenager/young adult: John says he "left the church" as a teenager and places his formal departure around age 20–21.
• Formal resignation process with a bishop: He recalls talking to a bishop and thinks he had to sign something, suggesting he went through an official membership resignation process rather than just becoming inactive.
• Family pattern of records/resignation issues: He mentions his baby sister, who was also baptized, apparently has no record either, which aligns with his own situation of not being found in the Church’s membership system after his resignation.

visit_title: Serena moving to Lutz in the next couple of months

Serena also recounted seeing her husband, Kevin, in a deteriorated state that she did not recognize him at a grocery store, highlighting his severe health decline and financial struggles. She mentioned renovating a house she is living in for free from well-to-do friends and plans to move in within a few months. Serena also talked about her friendship with a neighbor near the new house and her commitment to maintaining her covenants, including the laws of Chastity, Word of Wisdom, and Tithing.
